issue.title: [multiasic] Issue is shown on "sudo sfputil show presence" on a multiasic platform with minigraph generated config_db files

failure.body:
After sonic-buildimage picked up PR https://github.com/Azure/sonic-platform-common/pull/264,  command "sudo sfpulti show presence" and "eeprom" show the following back trace.   After an investigation:  On the multasic platform,  minigraph generates a partial port info (doesn't contains INDEX -- "physical_port")  and inserts to a PORT table in the CONFIG_DB in the host database if the port's external connection is specified in connection graph.  The get_port_config(hwsku, platform) call is able to get partial port info from host database in the multiasic platform.   Hence, PORT table is found in host database, and will not go the instance database get the port info.  And the logic ```fallback to hwsku/platform.json, fallback to port_config.ini.```  will not happened in this case.  If the configuration which is generated by minigraph is correct, then the get_port_config() or read_porttab_mappings() logic needs to be rewritten to support it on the multiasic platform.

BTW, it seems the following line in the sfputilhelper.py not doing what it supposes to do (remove internal ports) --'logical' is empty in this case

```
logical = [name for name in logical
                      if not name.startswith((backplane_prefix(), inband_prefix(), recirc_prefix()))]
```

resolution.title: [multiasic][sfputil]Fix the sftpuitlhelper on mutilasic platform issue
resolution.description:
#### Description
read_porttab_mappings() is not able to get the multiasic  port config.   Modified function read_porttab_mapings() to pass the asic_name to allow the get_port_config() to get the port info for each asic.  Also use the extend() and update() method to update the logical, logical_to_physical, phyiscal_to_logical lists.   Also add the unit test case test_read_all_porttab_mappings() .

#### Motivation and Context
This change is required to handle the mutliasic platform. Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/10569
